We request a partial refund of EUR 34.98 for the two unauthorised service lines; the Extended Care Plan is an unused intangible and the express shipping was not rendered, so no return is applicable.

filing.claim: The buyer's signed mandate (anchored in the payment authorisation) permitted a purchase only if the agent could obtain a genuine discount of at least 20% below the JBL Flip 7's usual market price (item_requirements.min_discount_vs_market_pct: 20). EUR 149.99), so the advertised -39% appears to be an inflated reference price rather than a genuine discount; under Directive 98/6/EC Art. 6a a price-reduction announcement must reference the lowest price applied in the prior 30 days. The mandate condition was therefore not met and the purchase should not have been made. We acknowledge the correct item in new condition was delivered on 2026-11-07 (carrier POD, weights match). We are not alleging non-delivery or a defective product. We request return of the unused speaker and a full refund of EUR 109.00. Independently of the mandate issue, the buyer is an EU consumer exercising the 14-day right of withdrawal (Directive 2011/83/EU, Art. 9), well within the window from delivery on 2026-11-07, and within MegaMart's own stated '14-day returns' policy. We ask MegaMart to substantiate the EUR 179 reference price (its lowest price in the 30 days before 2026-11-04) if it contests the discount claim.
